words.enDefinition: The process of looking for employment

examples.en: My job search began in January while I was still finishing my last course.
examples.zh: 我一月开始「求职」时，最后一门课还没上完。

examples.en: I started my job search close to campus because I don't have a car.
examples.zh: 我没有车，所以先从学校附近开始「找工作」。

words.enDefinition: To try to find paid employment

examples.en: I plan to look for work near campus after the exam period ends.
examples.zh: 我打算考试周结束后在学校附近「找工作」。

examples.en: Where did you look for work when you first moved to the city?
examples.zh: 你刚搬到这座城市时，是在哪儿「找工作」的？

words.enDefinition: A person looking for employment

examples.en: As a first-time job seeker, I asked the careers office where to start.
examples.zh: 作为第一次找工作的「求职者」，我问学校就业办公室该从哪里着手。

examples.en: The event is open to any job seeker who lives in the city.
examples.zh: 这场活动向住在本市的所有「求职者」开放。

words.enDefinition: The supply of jobs and people seeking them

examples.en: A careers adviser explained how the local job market changes when students leave for summer.
examples.zh: 就业顾问解释了学生暑假离校后，本地「就业市场」会怎么变化。

examples.en: I'm new to this city and don't know much about its job market.
examples.zh: 我刚到这座城市，对这里的「就业市场」不太了解。

words.enDefinition: Job opportunities that are not publicly advertised

examples.en: The workshop explained how people hear about vacancies in the hidden job market.
examples.zh: 讲座介绍了人们如何打听到「未公开的就业市场」里的空缺岗位。

examples.en: My tutor mentioned the hidden job market when I asked where graduates find work.
examples.zh: 我问毕业生从哪里找工作时，导师提到了「未公开的就业市场」。

collocations: tap into the hidden job market
opportunities in the hidden job market

words.enDefinition: Information pointing to a possible job opportunity

examples.en: A classmate gave me a job lead at a local bookshop last week.
examples.zh: 上周一位同学给了我一条「工作机会线索」，是本地一家书店的。

examples.en: I added the job lead to my notes and checked it after class.
examples.zh: 我把这条「工作机会线索」记下来，下课后查了一下。

collocations: follow up on a job lead

words.enDefinition: Learning about possible fields and types of work

examples.en: I used the first semester for career exploration while I tried different electives.
examples.zh: 我第一学期一边试着上不同的选修课，一边「探索职业方向」。

examples.en: The careers office set up a series of career exploration talks for first-year students.
examples.zh: 就业办公室为大一学生办了一系列「职业方向探索」讲座。

words.enDefinition: The direction a person's working life takes

examples.en: The speaker described her career path from campus radio to a local news station.
examples.zh: 演讲者介绍了她从校园广播电台到本地新闻台的「职业发展道路」。

examples.en: I spoke to two graduates who had taken a completely different career path.
examples.zh: 我和两位走上截然不同的「职业发展道路」的毕业生聊过。

words.enDefinition: Areas of work a person finds appealing

examples.en: I wrote down my career interests before meeting the adviser at the student centre.
examples.zh: 去学生中心见顾问之前，我先写下了自己的「职业兴趣」。

examples.en: My career interests changed after I spent a semester working at the gallery.
examples.zh: 在美术馆工作了一个学期后，我的「职业兴趣」变了。

words.enDefinition: Conditions used to decide which jobs to consider

examples.en: My job search criteria changed when I realised the last bus left at nine.
examples.zh: 发现末班公交九点就开走后，我调整了「求职筛选条件」。

examples.en: I shared my job search criteria with a friend who also needed weekend work.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「求职筛选条件」告诉了一位同样在找周末工作的朋友。

words.enDefinition: To look for jobs across more areas

examples.en: Did the careers adviser suggest that you broaden your job search beyond the city?
examples.zh: 就业顾问有没有建议你「扩大求职范围」，也看看市外的岗位？

examples.en: Would you broaden your job search if few nearby firms were hiring this term?
examples.zh: 如果这学期附近没几家公司招人，你会「扩大求职范围」吗？

collocations: decide to broaden your job search
help you broaden your job search

words.enDefinition: To focus on fewer kinds of opportunities

examples.en: How did you narrow your job search after finding so many listings yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天找到那么多招聘信息后，你是怎么「缩小求职范围」的？

examples.en: You can narrow your job search by choosing only the towns with direct trains.
examples.zh: 如果只选有直达火车的小镇，就能「缩小求职范围」。

collocations: narrow your job search by location
narrow your job search by industry
help you narrow your job search

words.enDefinition: To avoid committing to just one choice

examples.en: Did you keep your options open while you were waiting for news from the museum?
examples.zh: 等美术馆消息的时候，你有没有「保留其他选择」？

examples.en: It's easier to keep your options open when you have several companies to explore.
examples.zh: 有几家公司可以了解时，更容易「保留多种选择」。

collocations: keep your options open for now
try to keep your options open
prefer to keep your options open

words.enDefinition: The place where someone would most like to work

examples.en: I changed my preferred location after finding a flat near the main station.
examples.zh: 在中央车站附近找到公寓后，我改了自己的「意向工作地点」。

examples.en: The portal asked for my preferred location before it showed me any jobs.
examples.zh: 求职网站先让我填写「意向工作地点」，然后才显示职位。

words.enDefinition: A distance that can reasonably be traveled to work

examples.en: I wanted to find work within commuting distance of the flat I had just rented.
examples.zh: 我想找一份从刚租的公寓出发「可以通勤」的工作。

examples.en: Only two of the campus bookshops were within commuting distance of my new place.
examples.zh: 我从新住处出发，只有两家校园书店在「可通勤距离」内。

words.enDefinition: The maximum distance searched around a location

examples.en: I set the search radius to ten kilometres around the station in my town.
examples.zh: 我把「搜索半径」设为小镇车站周围十公里。

examples.en: The jobs page showed more listings after I increased the search radius on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上调大「搜索半径」后，求职页面显示了更多职位。

words.enDefinition: An option limiting results to selected places

examples.en: The location filter helped me find work on the same bus route as my flat.
examples.zh: 「地点筛选条件」帮我找到了和我住处在同一条公交线路上的工作。

examples.en: I removed the location filter when I wanted to see openings in neighbouring towns.
examples.zh: 我想看看邻近小镇的岗位时，就清除了「地点筛选条件」。

collocations: a location filter for nearby jobs

words.enDefinition: An option limiting results to a selected industry

examples.en: I used the industry filter to see only listings from museums and galleries.
examples.zh: 我用「行业筛选条件」，只看博物馆和美术馆发布的招聘信息。

examples.en: The industry filter grouped publishing and news under media on that job board.
examples.zh: 在那个求职网站上，「行业筛选条件」把出版和新闻都归到媒体类。

words.enDefinition: To find listings using the role's name

examples.en: The portal lets me search by job title when I know exactly what I want.
examples.zh: 明确想找什么工作时，我可以在平台上「按职位名称搜索」。

examples.en: Did you search by job title or just enter the name of the company?
examples.zh: 你是「按职位名称搜索」的，还是只输入了公司名称？

collocations: search by job title on a portal
choose to search by job title
search by job title and location

words.enDefinition: A search based on specific words entered

examples.en: I ran a keyword search for gallery work and found two local openings.
examples.zh: 我在「关键词搜索」里输入美术馆工作，找到了两个本地岗位。

examples.en: The keyword search brought up the same company under several different job titles.
examples.zh: 「关键词搜索」结果中，同一家公司出现在几个不同职位名称下。

collocations: a keyword search for local jobs

words.enDefinition: A word or phrase entered for searching

examples.en: I changed the search term from museum to gallery and got different results.
examples.zh: 我把「搜索词」从博物馆改成美术馆，结果就不一样了。

examples.en: That search term was too broad to find the kind of work I wanted.
examples.zh: 那个「搜索词」范围太广，搜不到我想找的那类工作。

words.enDefinition: An option limiting results by posting date

examples.en: I used the date posted filter to see what had appeared since Monday.
examples.zh: 我用了「发布日期筛选」，看周一以来有哪些新职位。

examples.en: The date posted filter lets me hide listings that are more than a month old.
examples.zh: 「发布日期筛选」可以隐藏一个多月前发布的职位。

collocations: choose an option in the date posted filter

words.zhGloss: 按发布时间从新到旧排序
words.enDefinition: To display the newest listings first
acceptedZhAnswers: 按发布时间从新到旧排序

examples.en: I usually sort by most recent when I check the university job board.
examples.zh: 我查看学校招聘板时，通常会「按发布时间从新到旧排序」。

examples.en: Can we sort by most recent so the new library jobs are at the top?
examples.zh: 我们能「按发布时间从新到旧排序」，把图书馆新发布的岗位放到最上面吗？

collocations: choose to sort by most recent
set the page to sort by most recent

words.enDefinition: Search settings stored for future use

examples.en: I opened a saved search instead of typing the same keywords again on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上打开了一个「已保存的搜索」，省得再输同样的关键词。

examples.en: The site let me give each saved search a name so I could tell them apart.
examples.zh: 网站让我给每个「已保存的搜索」起个名字，这样可以区分开。

words.enDefinition: A notification about a newly matching vacancy

examples.en: A job alert came through when the campus library posted a weekend vacancy.
examples.zh: 校园图书馆一发布周末岗位，我就收到一条「职位上新提醒」。

examples.en: I turned off one job alert after it kept sending jobs in another city.
examples.zh: 有一条「职位上新提醒」总给我推送外地岗位，我就把它关了。

words.enDefinition: A place where employers post job listings

examples.en: I found a weekend library position on a job board for local students.
examples.zh: 我在面向本地学生的「招聘信息平台」上找到了一个周末图书馆岗位。

examples.en: The same job board also lists work at cafés and shops near campus.
examples.zh: 同一个「招聘信息平台」上也有学校附近咖啡店和商店的工作。

words.enDefinition: A service gathering job listings from other sites

examples.en: The job aggregator showed the same shop vacancy from three different sources.
examples.zh: 这个「招聘信息聚合平台」展示了来自三个不同来源的同一个店员岗位。

examples.en: I went to the original listing after spotting the role on a job aggregator.
examples.zh: 我在「招聘信息聚合平台」上看到这个职位后，打开了招聘原帖。

collocations: a listing on a job aggregator

words.enDefinition: An employer's web page showing job opportunities

examples.en: The careers page listed a new library role that hadn't appeared elsewhere yet.
examples.zh: 「雇主招聘网页」列出了一个其他网站还没发布的图书馆新岗位。

examples.en: I saved the careers page to check for summer openings again next week.
examples.zh: 我收藏了「雇主招聘网页」，下周想再找找有没有新的暑期岗位。

words.enDefinition: A college service listing jobs for students

examples.en: The campus job board had even more listings when the new term began.
examples.zh: 新学期开始时，「校园招聘信息板」上的职位比之前还多。

examples.en: My roommate found the weekend library role on the campus job board.
examples.zh: 我室友在「校园招聘信息板」上找到了这个图书馆的周末岗位。

collocations: post on the campus job board

words.enDefinition: A company that matches workers with employers

examples.en: I asked the careers adviser whether the recruitment agency worked with local museums.
examples.zh: 我问就业顾问，这家「招聘中介机构」和本地博物馆有没有合作。

examples.en: A recruitment agency in town puts new graduates in touch with nearby employers.
examples.zh: 镇上的一家「招聘中介机构」会帮应届生联系附近的雇主。

words.enDefinition: A job board that serves a narrow field

examples.en: I found screen production work on a specialist job board for the media industry.
examples.zh: 我在传媒行业的「行业招聘平台」上找到了影视制作的工作。

examples.en: The careers adviser showed us a specialist job board for local arts organisations.
examples.zh: 就业顾问给我们介绍了一个为本地艺术机构服务的「行业招聘平台」。

collocations: advertise on a specialist job board
a listing from a specialist job board

words.enDefinition: Roles a service suggests based on your preferences

examples.en: I found a nearby museum among the recommended jobs on my account page.
examples.zh: 我在账户页面的「推荐职位」里看到了附近一家博物馆的岗位。

examples.en: My recommended jobs became more relevant once I switched the location to Bristol.
examples.zh: 把地点改成布里斯托尔后，我收到的「推荐职位」更合适了。

words.enDefinition: How often alert emails are sent

examples.en: I changed the email alert frequency after receiving messages every morning during exams.
examples.zh: 考试期间每天早上都收到消息，我就改了「邮件提醒频率」。

examples.en: The portal shows the email alert frequency next to each search I have saved.
examples.zh: 平台在我每条已保存的搜索旁显示了「邮件提醒频率」。

words.enDefinition: A summary of several job postings sent together

examples.en: The job digest arrives on Mondays and includes a few openings near campus.
examples.zh: 「职位信息汇总」每周一发来，里面有几个学校附近的空缺岗位。

examples.en: I read the job digest over breakfast instead of checking the website each morning.
examples.zh: 我早餐时读一下「职位信息汇总」，就不用每天早上都看那个网站了。

collocations: a listing in the job digest

words.enDefinition: Notices about jobs available in a nearby area

examples.en: I checked the local job listings before taking the bus into town on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六坐公交进城前，我先查了「本地职位信息」。

examples.en: The library keeps a folder of local job listings beside the front desk.
examples.zh: 图书馆前台旁放着一本「本地职位信息」汇编。

words.enDefinition: Short advertisements grouped by subject in a publication

examples.en: My neighbour found the café opening in the classified ads of the local paper.
examples.zh: 我邻居在当地报纸的「分类广告」里看到了咖啡店招人。

examples.en: The shop in the classified ads was just around the corner from our flat.
examples.zh: 「分类广告」里那家店就在我们公寓附近的拐角处。

collocations: find a job in the classified ads

words.enDefinition: A UK office offering public job search support

examples.en: My friend booked a session at the job centre before looking for work again.
examples.zh: 我朋友重新找工作前，在「就业服务中心」约了一次咨询。

examples.en: The job centre by the station has a noticeboard with vacancies from local shops.
examples.zh: 车站旁的「就业服务中心」有块公告板，贴着本地商店的招聘信息。

collocations: make an appointment at the job centre

words.enDefinition: A practical group session about finding work

examples.en: The job search workshop covered ways to find openings before they reach a major website.
examples.zh: 「求职工作坊」讲了怎样在大型网站发布招聘信息之前找到工作机会。

examples.en: I stayed after the job search workshop to ask which local employers regularly hire students.
examples.zh: 「求职工作坊」结束后，我留下来问了哪些本地雇主经常招学生。

collocations: sign up for a job search workshop

words.enDefinition: The features someone wants in a job

examples.en: I adjusted my work preferences to show that I was free only on weekends.
examples.zh: 我修改了自己的「工作偏好」，标明只有周末有空。

examples.en: Did the careers adviser ask you about your work preferences before suggesting those companies?
examples.zh: 就业顾问推荐那几家公司之前，有问过你的「工作偏好」吗？

words.enDefinition: Willing to move somewhere else for a job

examples.en: I'm open to relocation after graduation, so I added two more cities to my search.
examples.zh: 毕业后我「愿意为工作搬迁」，所以把另外两座城市也纳入了搜索范围。

examples.en: I told my adviser I was open to relocation once my lease ended.
examples.zh: 我告诉顾问，租约结束后我「愿意为工作搬迁」。

collocations: open to relocation for the right role

words.enDefinition: A job that is available for someone to fill

examples.en: The bookshop put a sign in the window when it had a vacancy.
examples.zh: 书店有「职位空缺」时，在橱窗里贴了招聘告示。

examples.en: I asked the librarian whether the vacancy was still listed on the university website.
examples.zh: 我问图书管理员，那个「空缺职位」是不是还挂在学校网站上。

collocations: a vacancy at a local shop

words.enDefinition: A role that has not been publicly listed

examples.en: My tutor heard about an unadvertised vacancy at a gallery near the university.
examples.zh: 我导师听说学校附近一家美术馆有个「未公开招聘的空缺」。

examples.en: The shop manager told me about an unadvertised vacancy when I asked about summer work.
examples.zh: 我去问暑期工作时，店长告诉我有个「未公开招聘的空缺」。

words.enDefinition: An event where job seekers meet employers

examples.en: I took the early bus so I could visit the career fair before class.
examples.zh: 我搭了早班公交，好在上课前先去逛「招聘会」。

examples.en: The career fair brought employers from the city and several neighbouring towns to campus.
examples.zh: 「招聘会」把本市和周边几个小镇的雇主请到了校园。

words.enDefinition: An online event connecting job seekers and employers

examples.en: I took part in a virtual career fair from my room during reading week.
examples.zh: 我在阅读周从宿舍参加了一场「线上招聘会」。

examples.en: The virtual career fair had separate video rooms for each employer and a shared schedule.
examples.zh: 「线上招聘会」给每家雇主安排了独立的视频会议室，大家共用一份日程表。

collocations: register for a virtual career fair

words.enDefinition: Recruitment aimed at students through a university

examples.en: The company usually starts campus recruitment when students return for the autumn term.
examples.zh: 学生秋季学期返校时，那家公司通常开始「校园招聘」。

examples.en: I first heard of that publisher because it took part in campus recruitment last year.
examples.zh: 我最早知道那家出版社，是因为它去年参加了「校园招聘」。

words.enDefinition: Recruiting people who recently completed a degree

examples.en: The annual report mentioned graduate recruitment in its section on plans for next year.
examples.zh: 这份年报在下一年计划部分提到了「应届毕业生招聘」。

examples.en: I asked when graduate recruitment would begin for students finishing their courses in June.
examples.zh: 我问六月结课的学生什么时候能参加「应届毕业生招聘」。

words.enDefinition: Someone who recruits students through university events

examples.en: A campus recruiter from the museum explained which sites were easiest to reach by bus.
examples.zh: 博物馆的一位「校园招聘人员」介绍了哪些场馆坐公交最方便到达。

examples.en: My classmate met a campus recruiter who also studied in our department years ago.
examples.zh: 我同学见到了一位「校园招聘人员」，对方多年前也在我们系读过书。

collocations: a campus recruiter visits a university

words.enDefinition: A meeting where an employer tells candidates about opportunities

examples.en: The employer information session took place in the library shortly after our afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午的讲座刚结束没多久，「雇主招聘说明会」就在图书馆开始了。

examples.en: After the employer information session, I knew which of their offices had student roles.
examples.zh: 参加完「雇主招聘说明会」，我知道了他们哪些办公室有学生岗位。

collocations: register for an employer information session

words.enDefinition: An employer's table or stand at a fair

examples.en: I stopped by the employer booth to ask about work at the local theatre.
examples.zh: 我去了「招聘单位展位」，询问本地剧院的工作机会。

examples.en: The queue in front of the employer booth wrapped around the central hall.
examples.zh: 「招聘单位展位」前排起的队伍绕了中央大厅一圈。

words.enDefinition: A list of organizations with stands at an event

examples.en: I checked the exhibitor list because I only had an hour at the fair.
examples.zh: 我只能在招聘会上待一个小时，所以先看了「参展单位名单」。

examples.en: The exhibitor list showed that two local radio stations would have booths this year.
examples.zh: 「参展单位名单」显示，今年两家本地广播电台会设展位。

words.enDefinition: An event where a company welcomes visitors inside

examples.en: We signed up for the company open house after meeting its staff at the fair.
examples.zh: 在招聘会上见过那家公司的员工后，我们报名参加了「企业开放日」。

examples.en: At the company open house, graduates showed us where they worked and answered questions.
examples.zh: 「企业开放日」上，毕业生带我们参观了他们工作的地方，也回答了问题。

collocations: invitations to a company open house

words.enDefinition: A guided visit to an employer's work premises

examples.en: The company tour included the workshop where they make props for local theatres.
examples.zh: 这次「企业参观活动」包括参观给当地剧院做道具的工坊。

examples.en: I booked the company tour because I wanted to see the studio for myself.
examples.zh: 我预约了「企业参观活动」，因为想亲眼看看那个工作室。

words.enDefinition: A group discussion where speakers share career experience

examples.en: The career panel included a librarian, a local journalist and two recent graduates.
examples.zh: 参加「职业经验交流座谈会」的有一位图书管理员、一位本地记者和两位应届毕业生。

examples.en: I asked a question at the career panel about moving between museums and galleries.
examples.zh: 我在「职业经验交流座谈会」上问了一个关于在博物馆和美术馆之间换工作的问题。

words.enDefinition: Watching someone at work to learn their role

examples.en: I arranged a morning of job shadowing with a librarian who studied here.
examples.zh: 我约了本校毕业的一位图书管理员，安排了一个上午的「跟岗观摩」。

examples.en: Job shadowing at the theatre showed me how the staff prepared for evening performances.
examples.zh: 在剧院「跟岗观摩」让我看到工作人员是怎么为晚场演出做准备的。

words.enDefinition: A regular publication about developments in an industry

examples.en: I started reading an industry newsletter to keep up with local studios and vacancies.
examples.zh: 我开始读一份「行业简报」，关注本地工作室的动态和招聘信息。

examples.en: The industry newsletter had a short notice about the theatre's open day in June.
examples.zh: 「行业简报」上有一条短消息，提到了剧院六月的开放日。

words.enDefinition: A university website with career information and services

examples.en: I used the university careers portal to book a place at the employer session.
examples.zh: 我通过「高校就业服务门户」预约了雇主说明会的席位。

examples.en: The university careers portal still showed events for graduates after I finished the course.
examples.zh: 我结课后，「高校就业服务门户」仍会显示面向毕业生的活动。

collocations: log in to the university careers portal
register on the university careers portal
resources on the university careers portal

words.enDefinition: A searchable list of people who attended a university

examples.en: I found an editor in the alumni directory who took the same course as me.
examples.zh: 我在「校友名录」里找到一位和我读过同一门课的编辑。

examples.en: The alumni directory lets graduates choose which contact details they share with other members.
examples.zh: 「校友名录」让毕业生自行选择向其他成员公开哪些联系方式。

collocations: be listed in an alumni directory

words.enDefinition: A former student who guides a current student

examples.en: My alumni mentor told me how she switched from university radio to editing podcasts.
examples.zh: 我的「校友导师」告诉我，她是怎么从校园电台转去做播客编辑的。

examples.en: I met my alumni mentor online while I was still exploring three different industries.
examples.zh: 我还在了解三个不同行业时，就在线上见到了我的「校友导师」。

collocations: be paired with an alumni mentor
get advice from an alumni mentor

words.enDefinition: To make professional connections with former students

examples.en: I went to the department's event to network with alumni who work in theatre.
examples.zh: 我去参加系里的活动，想「与在剧院工作的校友建立联系」。

examples.en: The club arranged an online evening for students to network with alumni living abroad.
examples.zh: 社团举办了一场线上晚会，让学生有机会「与在海外生活的校友建立联系」。

collocations: get a chance to network with alumni
network with alumni in your field

words.enDefinition: An informal gathering for people in one industry

examples.en: My classmate invited me to an industry meetup for people working in games.
examples.zh: 同学邀请我去参加一场游戏从业人员的「行业交流聚会」。

examples.en: The industry meetup gave me a chance to ask editors how they found their first jobs.
examples.zh: 这场「行业交流聚会」让我有机会问编辑们是怎么找到第一份工作的。

words.enDefinition: A membership organization for people working in a field

examples.en: I found the local professional association while looking for events for trainee librarians.
examples.zh: 我在找面向见习图书管理员的活动时，找到了当地的「专业人士协会」。

examples.en: The professional association has a student membership and holds talks open to the public.
examples.zh: 这个「专业人士协会」有学生会员，还办面向公众开放的讲座。

collocations: a member of a professional association

words.enDefinition: A set of contacts connected through work

examples.en: My professional network grew after I did some volunteer work at the film festival.
examples.zh: 我在电影节做了一些志愿服务后，「职业人脉网络」扩大了。

examples.en: She heard from her professional network that a new gallery would open next month.
examples.zh: 她从「职业人脉网络」得知，下个月会有一家新画廊开业。

words.enDefinition: A contact known to both people

examples.en: I noticed we had a mutual connection from the course I took last year.
examples.zh: 我注意到我们有个「共同认识的人」，是我去年上课认识的。

examples.en: A mutual connection at the library put me in touch with a former student.
examples.zh: 图书馆里一位「共同认识的人」帮我联系上了一名前学生。

collocations: be introduced by a mutual connection

words.enDefinition: A connection with someone you know only casually

examples.en: The speaker used an old classmate as an example of a weak tie.
examples.zh: 演讲者举了以前同班但并不熟的同学这个例子，来说明什么是「弱关系」。

examples.en: I heard about both openings through weak ties I made in my first year.
examples.zh: 这两个岗位都是我通过大一认识的「泛泛之交」打听到的。

words.enDefinition: An introduction arranged by someone both parties know

examples.en: My tutor made a warm introduction to an editor who used to take our course.
examples.zh: 导师给我做了次「熟人引荐」，介绍我认识一位也上过我们课程的编辑。

examples.en: It was easier to ask about the field after a warm introduction from a classmate.
examples.zh: 经同学「引荐」后，再向对方打听行业情况就容易多了。

words.enDefinition: To request that someone put you in touch

examples.en: I wanted to ask for an introduction to someone who works in local radio.
examples.zh: 我想「请人引荐」，认识一位在本地电台工作的人。

examples.en: Did you ask for an introduction when your tutor mentioned the graduate working there?
examples.zh: 导师提到有毕业生在那儿工作时，你有没有「请他引荐」？

collocations: ask for an introduction to an alumnus
ask for an introduction by email

words.enDefinition: A recommendation made by a current employee

examples.en: The museum's website explains how an employee referral is recorded in its system.
examples.zh: 博物馆网站说明了系统会如何记录「员工内推」。

examples.en: Someone I worked with before offered an employee referral for the museum's education role.
examples.zh: 一位前同事主动提出帮我「内推」博物馆的教育岗位。

words.enDefinition: An employer's scheme for staff to recommend candidates

examples.en: My former colleague said her company had a referral programme for open roles.
examples.zh: 我以前的同事说，她所在的公司有针对空缺职位的「员工内推计划」。

examples.en: The referral programme was described on a separate page from the public vacancy list.
examples.zh: 「员工内推计划」的说明和公开岗位列表放在不同的页面上。

words.enDefinition: Someone a person worked with before

examples.en: A former colleague sent me a link to an opening at the city library.
examples.zh: 一位「前同事」发我一个链接，是市图书馆的空缺岗位。

examples.en: I ran into a former colleague while I was queuing at the career fair.
examples.zh: 我在招聘会上排队时，碰到了一位「前同事」。

collocations: get in touch with a former colleague
a recommendation from a former colleague

words.enDefinition: Someone you know who works in an industry

examples.en: An industry contact told me that theatre jobs are often advertised in the spring.
examples.zh: 一位「业内联系人」告诉我，剧院岗位通常在春季发布。

examples.en: I asked an industry contact where editors in the city usually look for work.
examples.zh: 我向一位「业内联系人」打听，这座城市的编辑通常去哪里找工作。

collocations: keep in touch with an industry contact

words.enDefinition: A conversation to learn about someone's work

examples.en: I arranged an informational interview with a graduate who works at a book publisher.
examples.zh: 我约了一位在出版社工作的毕业生做「职业信息访谈」。

examples.en: During the informational interview, I asked what a typical day at the museum looked like.
examples.zh: 「职业信息访谈」期间，我问了在博物馆工作的一天通常怎么过。

words.enDefinition: A very short spoken summary of what you offer

examples.en: I practised my elevator pitch with my roommate before we went to the fair.
examples.zh: 去招聘会之前，我和室友一起练了「简短自荐」。

examples.en: My elevator pitch mentions the three months I spent working at the local museum.
examples.zh: 我的「简短自荐」里提到，我在本地博物馆工作过三个月。

words.enDefinition: To ask someone for their knowledge or advice

examples.en: Can I pick your brain about jobs in museums before I choose my final modules?
examples.zh: 选最后几门课之前，我能「向你请教」一下博物馆工作的情况吗？

examples.en: Could we pick your brain about how you got your first job in publishing?
examples.zh: 能不能「向你请教」一下，你是怎么找到第一份出版工作的？

collocations: pick someone's brain about a field
get a chance to pick someone's brain

words.enDefinition: To share ways of contacting each other

examples.en: We got a chance to exchange contact details before the exhibition hall closed.
examples.zh: 展厅关门前，我们有机会「交换联系方式」。

examples.en: Did you exchange contact details with the graduate who spoke after the break?
examples.zh: 你和休息后发言的那位毕业生「交换联系方式」了吗？

collocations: exchange contact details after an event
exchange contact details with a speaker

words.enDefinition: A site for making and maintaining work contacts

examples.en: I found the editor through a professional networking site after reading her article.
examples.zh: 读完那位编辑的文章后，我通过「职业社交网站」找到了她。

examples.en: The careers adviser suggested using a professional networking site to find former students in publishing.
examples.zh: 就业顾问建议上「职业社交网站」，找在出版行业工作的校友。

collocations: create a profile on a professional networking site

words.enDefinition: The setting controlling who can see a profile

examples.en: I changed my profile visibility before joining the university's professional networking group.
examples.zh: 加入学校的职业社交小组之前，我更改了「资料可见范围」。

examples.en: The settings page lets me check my profile visibility without changing any contact details.
examples.zh: 设置页面可以让我查看「资料可见范围」，无须修改联系方式。

words.enDefinition: Available for and interested in new employment

examples.en: The site lets me show that I'm open to work after my course finishes.
examples.zh: 这个网站可以让我标明，结课后我「会找工作」。

examples.en: I told a former colleague I was open to work from the start of July.
examples.zh: 我告诉一位前同事，从七月初开始我「愿意接受工作机会」。

collocations: show that you're open to work
let people know you're open to work
mark your profile as open to work

words.enDefinition: The spread of information through personal conversations

examples.en: I heard about the bookshop vacancy by word of mouth while waiting for a bus.
examples.zh: 等公交时，我听到人们「口头转告」书店有空缺，就知道了这份工作。

examples.en: Some students found out about the weekend roles through word of mouth at the library.
examples.zh: 一些学生是在图书馆听别人「口头转告」，才知道有周末岗位。

words.enDefinition: To ask people you know for information or help

examples.en: When did you reach out to your network about work at the local theatre?
examples.zh: 你是什么时候「联系人脉」，打听本地剧院工作机会的？

examples.en: Did you reach out to your network before you started looking in another city?
examples.zh: 开始在另一座城市找工作前，你有「联系自己的人脉」吗？

collocations: reach out to your network for leads
decide to reach out to your network
reach out to your network for advice

words.enDefinition: To speak favorably about someone to help them

examples.en: My old supervisor offered to put in a good word with the gallery manager.
examples.zh: 以前的主管主动提出帮我在画廊经理面前「说几句好话」。

examples.en: Did anyone put in a good word for you at the bookshop near campus?
examples.zh: 有没有人在学校附近那家书店「替你说过好话」？

collocations: offer to put in a good word
put in a good word for a friend
put in a good word with a manager

words.expression: get your foot in the door
words.lemma: get your foot in the door
words.enDefinition: To gain an initial opportunity in an organization or field
acceptedEnVariants: get your foot in the door

examples.en: Did the weekend shifts help you get your foot in the door at the theatre?
examples.zh: 周末班有没有帮你「获得进入剧院工作的机会」？

examples.en: It can take a while to get your foot in the door in local radio.
examples.zh: 要「获得踏入本地广播行业的机会」，可能得花些时间。

collocations: a chance to get your foot in the door
help you get your foot in the door
try to get your foot in the door

words.enDefinition: To resume communication with someone you knew before

examples.en: The event gave me a chance to reconnect with a contact from my placement.
examples.zh: 这次活动让我有机会「重新联系一位实习期间认识的人」。

examples.en: I used the alumni directory to reconnect with a contact from my final year.
examples.zh: 我通过校友名录「重新联系上了最后一年认识的一位旧识」。

collocations: try to reconnect with a contact
reconnect with a contact from university
an opportunity to reconnect with a contact

words.enDefinition: A page summarizing someone's work background and interests

examples.en: I updated my professional profile so other graduates could see the course I'd taken.
examples.zh: 我更新了「职业社交资料」，方便其他毕业生看到我读过的课程。

examples.en: Her professional profile helped me understand how she moved from teaching into publishing.
examples.zh: 她的「职业社交资料」让我了解了她是怎样从教学转行到出版的。

words.enDefinition: A person known through someone you are friends with

examples.en: A friend of a friend told me that the library was hiring evening staff.
examples.zh: 「朋友的朋友」告诉我，图书馆在招晚班人员。

examples.en: I found out about the publishing event through a friend of a friend.
examples.zh: 我通过一位「朋友的朋友」得知了这次出版行业活动。

collocations: hear from a friend of a friend
meet a friend of a friend
an introduction from a friend of a friend

words.enDefinition: Looking up information about places you might work

examples.en: I did some employer research before deciding which stands to visit at the fair.
examples.zh: 确定先逛哪些展位之前，我先做了些「雇主调研」。

examples.en: The library guide links to public records that students can use for employer research.
examples.zh: 图书馆指南提供了公开资料的链接，学生可以用来做「雇主调研」。

words.enDefinition: An organization that might employ someone in future

examples.en: I met a prospective employer at the arts fair and learned about their local studio.
examples.zh: 我在艺术展上见到一家「潜在雇主」，了解了他们在本地的工作室。

examples.en: The careers adviser asked what I wanted to know about each prospective employer.
examples.zh: 就业顾问问我想了解每家「潜在雇主」的哪些情况。

words.enDefinition: A reduced list of employers worth considering

examples.en: I added the gallery to my shortlist of employers after visiting its new space.
examples.zh: 参观画廊的新场地后，我把它加进了「重点关注的雇主名单」。

examples.en: My shortlist of employers now has three places I could easily reach by train.
examples.zh: 我的「重点关注的雇主名单」里现在有三家坐火车很方便就能到的单位。

collocations: add a company to a shortlist of employers

words.enDefinition: A brief summary of an organization's activities

examples.en: The company overview explained what the studio makes and where its teams are based.
examples.zh: 「公司概况」介绍了工作室制作什么作品，以及它的团队分布在哪里。

examples.en: I read the company overview before joining the firm's online careers session on Friday.
examples.zh: 参加公司周五的线上招聘说明会之前，我先读了「公司概况」。

words.enDefinition: An account of an employer written by a worker

examples.en: I read an employee review from someone who used to work at the branch.
examples.zh: 我读了一篇「员工对公司的评价」，作者曾在那家分店工作。

examples.en: The employee review focused on the training offered to staff during their first month.
examples.zh: 这篇「员工对公司的评价」主要讲了入职第一个月有哪些培训。

words.enDefinition: The shared habits and values of a workplace

examples.en: The graduates on the panel described the company culture at two very different studios.
examples.zh: 参加交流会的毕业生介绍了两家很不一样的工作室各自的「公司文化」。

examples.en: I asked about company culture because I wanted to know how the staff worked together.
examples.zh: 我问了「公司文化」，因为我想知道那里的员工是怎么合作的。

words.enDefinition: Principles an organization says guide its work

examples.en: The website lists the company values beside examples of projects from the past year.
examples.zh: 网站把「公司价值观」和过去一年的项目案例并排列出。

examples.en: I asked how the company values affected the way teams chose new projects.
examples.zh: 我问「公司价值观」是怎么影响团队选择新项目的。

words.enDefinition: The purpose an organization says it serves

examples.en: The company mission was explained on the first page of the studio's booklet.
examples.zh: 工作室的宣传册在第一页介绍了「公司使命」。

examples.en: I wanted to know whether the company mission had changed after the merger last year.
examples.zh: 我想知道去年合并后，「公司使命」有没有改变。

words.enDefinition: Expectations about how an industry may develop

examples.en: The guest speaker discussed the industry outlook for publishing over the next few years.
examples.zh: 嘉宾谈了未来几年的出版「行业前景」。

examples.en: I read the industry outlook before choosing a few companies to learn more about.
examples.zh: 选几家公司深入了解之前，我先看了「行业前景」。

words.enDefinition: An industry expanding in output, demand, or employment

examples.en: The report called animation a growth industry in the region after several studios opened.
examples.zh: 几家工作室开张后，报告把动画列为当地的「增长型行业」。

examples.en: She wanted to learn whether film production was still a growth industry in the city.
examples.zh: 她想了解影视制作在这座城市是否仍是一个「增长型行业」。

words.enDefinition: A pattern in how employers recruit over time

examples.en: One hiring trend in the report was a rise in part-time evening roles.
examples.zh: 报告提到的一项「招聘趋势」是晚间兼职岗位增多。

examples.en: The lecturer asked whether the summer hiring trend would continue into the autumn term.
examples.zh: 讲师问，夏季的「招聘趋势」会不会延续到秋季学期。

words.enDefinition: The chances of finding work in an area or field

examples.en: I asked former students about job prospects in publishing before choosing my final modules.
examples.zh: 选最后几门课前，我向校友打听了出版行业的「就业前景」。

examples.en: The report compared job prospects in three cities with direct trains from the university.
examples.zh: 报告比较了从学校坐火车可直达的三座城市的「就业前景」。

words.enDefinition: Employers' need for people to work

examples.en: The report says demand for workers rises near the coast during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 报告说，暑假期间沿海地区的「用工需求」会上升。

examples.en: I checked demand for workers in local theatres before deciding where to look.
examples.zh: 决定去哪里找工作前，我查了本地剧院的「用工需求」。

words.enDefinition: Figures describing employment, job openings, and related conditions

examples.en: Our adviser showed us labour market data for the cities closest to the university.
examples.zh: 就业顾问给我们看了离学校最近几座城市的「劳动力市场数据」。

examples.en: I used labour market data to compare job prospects in two parts of the country.
examples.zh: 我用「劳动力市场数据」比较了这个国家两个地区的就业前景。

words.enDefinition: Looking up typical pay for particular jobs

examples.en: My salary research showed that the same role paid differently in the two cities.
examples.zh: 我的「薪资调研」显示，同一岗位在两座城市的待遇不同。

examples.en: The careers office offers links to reports that are useful for salary research.
examples.zh: 学校就业办公室提供了一些有助于「薪资调研」的报告链接。

collocations: a starting point for salary research

words.enDefinition: A study collecting information about what workers earn

examples.en: I found a salary survey that broke down pay by city and type of employer.
examples.zh: 我找到一份「薪酬调查」，按城市和雇主类型细分了薪资。

examples.en: The salary survey included recent graduates who had joined local publishing firms that year.
examples.zh: 这份「薪酬调查」纳入了当年入职本地出版社的应届毕业生。

collocations: take part in a salary survey

words.enDefinition: How often staff leave and are replaced

examples.en: A graduate mentioned high staff turnover when we talked about jobs in local museums.
examples.zh: 我们聊到本地博物馆的工作时，一位毕业生提到那里「员工流动」频繁。

examples.en: I asked how staff turnover had changed since the studio moved to the city.
examples.zh: 我问工作室搬到城里后，「员工流动」有什么变化。

words.enDefinition: A period when many employers actively recruit

examples.en: The careers office stays open later during hiring season so more students can ask questions.
examples.zh: 「集中招聘季」期间，就业办公室延长了开放时间，让更多学生能来咨询。

examples.en: I did my employer research before the local theatre's hiring season began in April.
examples.zh: 本地剧院四月开始「集中招聘季」之前，我已经做了雇主调研。

words.enDefinition: A temporary stop on taking on new staff

examples.en: The studio announced a hiring freeze just as I started looking for local work.
examples.zh: 我刚开始在本地找工作，那家工作室就宣布「暂停招聘」。

examples.en: The company lifted its hiring freeze shortly before the university's spring career fair.
examples.zh: 学校的春季招聘会开幕前不久，那家公司结束了「暂停招聘」。

words.enDefinition: A recurring period in which an employer recruits

examples.en: The recruitment cycle starts much earlier for some publishers than it does for theatres.
examples.zh: 有些出版社的「招聘周期」比剧院开始得早很多。

examples.en: The careers adviser explained when museums usually begin their recruitment cycle for summer work.
examples.zh: 就业顾问介绍了博物馆的暑期岗位「招聘周期」通常什么时候开始。

words.enDefinition: How large an employer is, often measured by staffing

examples.en: The site lets me search by company size as well as by industry.
examples.zh: 这个网站除了能按行业搜索，还能按「公司规模」搜索。

examples.en: Company size mattered to me because I wanted to learn how a small studio operates.
examples.zh: 我在意「公司规模」，因为我想了解小型工作室是怎么运作的。

words.enDefinition: An industry someone intends to focus on

examples.en: I chose publishing as my target sector after talking with two former students.
examples.zh: 和两位校友聊过后，我选了出版作为「目标行业」。

examples.en: My adviser asked me to name a target sector before we looked for employers.
examples.zh: 在我们找雇主之前，就业顾问让我先说出一个「目标行业」。

words.enDefinition: To subscribe to updates from an employer

examples.en: On this site, I can follow a company and see when it posts openings.
examples.zh: 在这个网站上，我可以「关注一家公司」，查看它何时发布新岗位。

examples.en: Did you follow a company after discovering its page on the careers portal?
examples.zh: 你在就业服务门户上找到一家公司的页面后，有没有「关注那家公司」？

collocations: follow a company on a job board

words.enDefinition: A fraud aimed at people looking for work

examples.en: The workshop used a sample message to show how a job scam might begin.
examples.zh: 工作坊用一封示例消息演示了「求职诈骗」可能怎么开始。

examples.en: The careers office told me where to report a job scam involving a fake recruiter.
examples.zh: 就业办公室告诉我该向哪里举报冒充招聘人员的「求职诈骗」。

words.enDefinition: A listing for a job that does not exist

examples.en: I reported a fake job posting that used the name of a nearby museum.
examples.zh: 我举报了一条冒用附近博物馆名称的「虚假招聘信息」。

examples.en: The careers office removed the fake job posting after a student flagged it.
examples.zh: 一名学生举报后，学校就业办公室移除了这条「虚假招聘信息」。

words.enDefinition: To check that an employer is genuine

examples.en: My adviser showed me how to verify an employer using the company's official website.
examples.zh: 就业顾问教我如何通过公司官网「核实雇主身份」。

examples.en: The career portal lets students verify an employer before sharing any contact information.
examples.zh: 就业门户让学生在分享任何联系方式前先「核实雇主身份」。

collocations: take time to verify an employer

words.enDefinition: A listing past its advertised closing date

examples.en: I bookmarked an expired posting by mistake because it still appeared in the search results.
examples.zh: 我误收藏了一条「已过期的招聘信息」，因为它还出现在搜索结果中。

examples.en: The job board added a grey label to each expired posting in my search.
examples.zh: 招聘平台在我的搜索结果里，给每条「已过期的招聘信息」加了灰色标签。

words.enDefinition: A job listing published again after an earlier posting

examples.en: I recognised a reposted job because the description matched one I'd read last month.
examples.zh: 我认出这是个「重新发布的职位」，因为它和我上月看过的职位描述一样。

examples.en: The reposted job appeared near the top of the results on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 周一早上，那个「重新发布的职位」出现在搜索结果的前几条。

words.enDefinition: Another posting for the same advertised role

examples.en: I removed the duplicate listing after noticing that both entries had the same reference.
examples.zh: 发现两条信息的编号一样后，我删掉了「重复发布的招聘信息」。

examples.en: A duplicate listing appeared when the search included both the agency and the employer.
examples.zh: 搜索结果同时包含中介和雇主发布的岗位时，出现了一条「重复发布的招聘信息」。

words.enDefinition: A tool for organizing opportunities and next steps

examples.en: I added a column to my job search tracker for the links I wanted to revisit.
examples.zh: 我在「求职进度记录工具」里加了一列，放想回头再看的链接。

examples.en: The job search tracker helped me remember which employers I'd already looked up that week.
examples.zh: 「求职进度记录工具」帮我记住那周已经查过哪些雇主。

collocations: set up a job search tracker

words.enDefinition: To save a job link to revisit later

examples.en: Can I bookmark a vacancy from the results page without opening the entire advert?
examples.zh: 我能直接在结果页「收藏一条招聘信息」，不用打开完整启事吗？

examples.en: I wanted to bookmark a vacancy before my phone lost its connection on the train.
examples.zh: 火车上手机断网之前，我想先「收藏一条招聘信息」。

words.enDefinition: A regular pattern of looking for work

examples.en: My job search routine changed when classes moved to the afternoons in the spring.
examples.zh: 春季学期的课挪到下午后，我的「日常求职安排」变了。

examples.en: I found a job search routine that fit around my shifts at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我找到了一个能配合校园咖啡店班次的「日常求职安排」。

collocations: stick to a job search routine

words.enDefinition: Tiredness caused by a long period of looking for work

examples.en: Job search fatigue set in after I spent several weeks checking the same websites.
examples.zh: 连着几周翻来覆去查同几个网站后，我开始有了「求职疲惫感」。

examples.en: We talked about job search fatigue at a peer meeting in the student centre.
examples.zh: 我们在学生中心的同伴交流会上聊了「求职疲惫感」。

words.enDefinition: A group where people support one another while job hunting

examples.en: I joined a job search support group organised by students in their final year.
examples.zh: 我参加了毕业班学生组织的「求职互助小组」。

examples.en: The job search support group meets on Thursdays near the entrance to the library.
examples.zh: 「求职互助小组」每周四在图书馆入口附近见面。

collocations: join a job search support group
run a job search support group
attend a job search support group

words.enDefinition: A deliberate move into a different kind of work

examples.en: My mentor talked about her career pivot from book design to museum education.
examples.zh: 我的导师谈到她从书籍设计转向博物馆教育的「职业转向」。

examples.en: I wanted to hear how graduates managed a career pivot after their first job.
examples.zh: 我想听听毕业生在第一份工作之后是怎么完成「职业转向」的。

words.enDefinition: A lack of workers to fill available jobs

examples.en: The city report noted a labour shortage in some trades near the end of summer.
examples.zh: 市里的报告提到，夏末一些工种出现了「劳动力短缺」。

examples.en: The speaker discussed how the labour shortage had affected hiring at local hotels.
examples.zh: 演讲者谈到「劳动力短缺」怎样影响了本地酒店招聘。

words.enDefinition: A public notice that an employer is recruiting

examples.en: The theatre shared a hiring announcement on its page before the weekend performances.
examples.zh: 周末演出开始前，剧院在自己的网页上发布了「招募公告」。

examples.en: I saw the hiring announcement while looking up events at the museum on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五查博物馆活动时，我看到了那则「招募公告」。

words.enDefinition: An organized list of employers to look up

examples.en: I searched the employer directory for museums within an easy train ride of campus.
examples.zh: 我在「雇主名录」里查有哪些博物馆从学校坐火车容易到达。

examples.en: The employer directory lists companies that have taken part in events at the university.
examples.zh: 「雇主名录」列出了参加过学校活动的公司。

words.enDefinition: A tool exploring interests and strengths related to work

examples.en: I took a career assessment before choosing which employer events to attend that term.
examples.zh: 决定那学期参加哪些雇主活动之前，我做了一次「职业方向测评」。

examples.en: The careers adviser asked what I thought of the results from my career assessment.
examples.zh: 就业顾问问我对「职业方向测评」的结果有什么想法。

words.enDefinition: What graduates do after finishing a course

examples.en: The course page listed graduate outcomes from the past five years, including further study.
examples.zh: 课程页面列出了过去五年的「毕业生去向」，包括继续深造的情况。

examples.en: I looked at graduate outcomes to find out which sectors former students had entered.
examples.zh: 我看了「毕业生去向」，想知道校友进了哪些行业。

words.enDefinition: Recent developments that an organization makes public

examples.en: I checked the company news for updates about the studio before attending its open day.
examples.zh: 去参加工作室的开放日之前，我看了「企业近况」，了解它的最新动态。

examples.en: The company news on the website included plans to open an office near campus.
examples.zh: 网站上的「企业近况」提到，他们计划在学校附近开设办公点。
